step: B (intends tier) and B2 (reasoning harvest spike)
rule: Floors are predeclared; a tier below its floor is reported, never retuned.

intentsTier.source: the live suite's epistemic tier filtered to tag 'intends' (liveReadTiers already carries tag/subject/content; the scorer needs an 'intents' tier that scores exactly those rows)
intentsTier.fixtures: 14 fixtures test/fixtures/extractor-intents01..14 (+ goldens test/goldens/extractor-intents*.response.txt): 9 where a character states or shows an aim in its own dialogue/action (01-08 and 14; 02 has two speakers, 04 and 14 have a player line stating the player's own aim beside an NPC aim, 05 has a silent character), 2 where only the player's narration implies an NPC aim (09, 10: expect none), 2 with meta-commentary in the reply (11 OOC, 12 [Note: as an AI]: only the in-character aim counts), 1 third-party report (13: Greta says Wulf plans to leave; expect none). extractor23-25 (epistemic) are NOT given intents: their expected.json files are hash-frozen by liveSuiteScore.test (v2.5 plan 05 F2).
intentsTier.deterministicHalf: src/memory/innerVoice.test.ts (evidence rule: player-attributed and meta-commentary dropped) and src/runtime/coordinators/innerVoiceInjection.review.test.ts
intentsTier.claimShape: expected.intents = {expect: [{subject, anyOf: [needle...]}], players?: [...]}; a live epistemic row with tag intends matches the first open claim with the same subject whose content contains any needle (case-insensitive, one row per claim). expect: [] claims none. none/scope as the other tiers.
intentsTier.scoring: precision = matched / (matched + spurious) over every live intends row (a player-attributed row is spurious too); recall = matched / expected; playerAttributed = rows whose subject is a listed player or an is_user transcript speaker. Scored on the RAW parsed read (before admitIntents), so it measures the model, not the guard. scripts/debug/lib/liveSuiteScore.mts scoreIntents/intentsTotals.

b2Harvest.switch: settings.memory.harvestReasoning = true (default absent = off, Resolved table)
b2Harvest.what: message.extra.reasoning of each character reply in the P2 window is fed to the epistemic pass as that character's own evidence for its [intends] lines (meta-commentary sentences removed first)
b2Harvest.procedure: on a Chat Completion profile that returns reasoning (plan 05 F7), replay the intents fixtures with extra.reasoning attached; score precision of intents whose only evidence is the reasoning, and the share of meta sentences ('I should write...', 'the user wants...') that never reach a row
b2Harvest.ifBelowFloor: recorded not built: the switch stays off and its settings key is removed
